title: Exact Brand Name on Label
tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

judge.summary: A polished product photo shows an amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label and clear, correctly spelled VELORA branding.

must_haves.item: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
must_haves.why: The centered amber glass bottle has a black dispensing pump and is labeled HAND SOAP.

must_haves.item: A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
must_haves.why: A cream label visibly wraps around the bottle body.

must_haves.item: The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
must_haves.why: The brand reads VELORA in large, clear uppercase lettering.

must_haves.item: The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
must_haves.why: The lettering is centered within the cream label and looks printed on it.

must_haves.item: The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.
must_haves.why: All six letters are fully visible, high-contrast, and readily readable.

title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: Some non-paint details were subtly regenerated, including the far-side rear light and bumper outline, background house details, and road cracks near the lower-right corner.

judge.summary: The car is convincingly navy blue with natural sunny reflections, but a few details outside the paint were subtly changed.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The body panels and roof are now a clearly dark navy blue.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: The overall car is closely preserved, but the far-side rear light and rear bumper contour show small changes.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The blue paint retains bright highlights, reflected houses, and shaded lower panels consistent with the sunny scene.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: Small changes are visible in background architectural details and the lower-right road cracks.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and aspect ratio without visible cropping.

title: Warmer Without Recreating The Scene
tests: Tests whether a terse warmth tweak applies a colour adjustment to the existing image without regenerating or charging for the scene twice.

faults.what: The open book contains visible printed text, contrary to the request for no text, although individual words are not clearly readable.
The mug sits on the open book rather than beside it.

judge.summary: The square image has attractive warm daylight, but visible book text violates the request, and the colour-only edit cannot be verified without the earlier image.

must_haves.item: The final image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the first output.
must_haves.why: Only one image is provided; it looks warm, but there is no earlier output to compare.

must_haves.item: The same blue ceramic mug, open book and wooden windowsill remain in exactly the same positions.
must_haves.why: All three objects are visible, but their original positions cannot be checked without the earlier image.

must_haves.item: Framing, object shapes, book details and background details are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: No comparison image is supplied to establish whether these details stayed unchanged.

must_haves.item: The image is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, but printed text is visibly present across the book's pages.
